verdict.rationale: Elastic APM's own docs state that errors are grouped based primarily on the stack trace, and that you can identify new errors as they appear and track how often specific errors occur. That covers the grouping-into-issues and stack-trace core of the story. Nothing in the pack documents release tracking, and spotting new errors is not the same as detecting regressions of previously resolved issues. missing for 10: release/version tracking of errors, regression detection for resolved issues, detailed stack-trace UI documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see application errors grouped into issues with stack traces, release tracking, and regression detection

citations.quote: Errors are grouped based primarily on the stack trace, so you can identify new errors as they appear and keep an eye on how many times specific errors happen.
